title: paphiopedilum insigne var. sanderae

This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing pain and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Paphiopedilum insigne var. sanderae are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids and flavonoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-cancer activities.
